data.narrative:
Vital Lyfe is a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Jonathan Criss and Andrew Harner that has raised $24M to date. The climate and energy sector includes 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (LNZA), though no narrow peer set of same-stage or adjacent-stage companies with similar valuation tiers exists with sufficient density for reliable median-based triangulation.

The Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable approach, using the $24M total raised as a base value proxy and applying a typical Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x. This yields an implied valuation of $60M. The Peer-Median method was not applied due to insufficient datapoints—while 9 same-sector peers exist (including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen), filtering for stage-relevant or valuation-tier-aligned comparables yielded fewer than three observations, which would produce misleading results.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $51M (low) to $69M (high), with a median point of $60M. This range reflects modest downside and upside around the stage-progression anchor. Key uncertainties include the absence of true peer-set triangulation—reliance on a single method leaves the estimate exposed to stage-progression multiplier variance—and the nascent, heterogeneous nature of frontier climate tech, which limits comparable company applicability. A fuller view would require revenue trajectory, capital efficiency, or technology milestone data not present in this dataset.
